title: chamaesyce celastroides var. laehiensis
intro: Chamaesyce celastroides var. laehiensis, commonly known as the Lae'ie plant, is a species of flowering plant in the spurge family, Euphorbiaceae. The Lae'ie plant is traditionally used in Hawaiian medicine for its health benefits, which include treating skin conditions, wounds, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which help to soothe and heal the skin. The bioactive constituents of the Lae'ie plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
